# Signal to Insight

> A personalized source-to-understanding engine that turns videos, papers, articles, repositories, tools, documentation and other useful sources into coherent visual explanations, concept/tool maps and practical learning decisions.

Canonical project: https://github.com/dkharlanau/signal-to-insight
Site: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/
Research profile: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/config/research-profile.json
Machine-readable insights: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/data/insights.json
Source registry: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/data/sources.json
Schema: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/data/insight.schema.json

## Core behavior

The project does not optimize for generic summarization. The intended transformation is:

source → whole-source map → personalized selection → verification/enrichment → coherent mental model → tools/concepts → action map → visual explainer

Selection should retain all prerequisites and relationships required for coherent understanding, even when some parts are not individually exciting.

The project is not domain-locked. SAP/enterprise can be an application when appropriate, but AI tools, developer systems, custom architectures, research and other high-leverage topics are equally valid.

## Required provenance

Every published record should include:

- canonical source;
- creator/publisher when known;
- publication date when verifiable;
- event date when relevant;
- capture/access date;
- analysis/review date;
- supporting sources used for verification or enrichment.

Unknown dates must not be guessed.

## Content principles

- Prefer coherent mental models over disconnected takeaways.
- Explain prerequisites that the source assumes but the reader needs.
- Distinguish source claims from project-added research and interpretation.
- Prefer official/primary sources for tool and technical verification.
- Include limitations and counterpoints.
- End in explicit learning/action decisions: use, try, learn, build, watch or ignore for now.
- Use visuals to explain mechanisms, relationships, comparisons or sequences; decorative visuals are secondary.
- Link to original sources rather than reproducing them.
- Do not store full third-party transcripts in the public repository.

## Published case 001

### Why enterprise AI agents fail after the POC

Primary source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mav15aW9lLM
Event: AI Engineer World's Fair 2026
Event date: 2026-07-02
Captured/analyzed: 2026-08-26
YouTube publication date: not independently verified

Core model: production readiness depends on the controlled execution environment around an AI agent — including authority, durable/reconstructable history, protected data access, human intervention and replay — rather than model capability alone.

Adjacent learning tools added by this project: Temporal, OpenTelemetry and Open Policy Agent.

Structured record: /data/insights.json
Source record: /data/sources.json
Human-readable explainer: /content/explainers/001-enterprise-agent-production-substrate.md
